learning_outcomes.text: Lectures give knowledge about basics of instruments design in order student would be able to design different kinds of mechanical and optomechanical instruments. Lectures highlight differences between design of standard mechanical engineering systems and measurements instruments.

syllabus_topics: Solution of examples and a review of design parts
bibliography: Trylinski, W., Fine mechnanisms and precision instruments, principles of design, Pergamin Press, Warshaw, 1971
Yoder, P., R., Jr., Opto-Mechanical system design, SpiePress, Washington, 2005
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
